description: This file implements a command-line interface for toggling and managing stdout metrics, including subcommand handling, execution, and creation of the command object.

classes.name: toggle_stdout_metrics_app_command
classes.description: Class managing the toggle command for stdout metrics, including subcommand execution and state management.

methods.name: generate_command_description
methods.description: Generates a description string for the command, listing available metrics.

methods.name: get_subcommand_names
methods.description: Retrieves the list of subcommand names from the available subcommands.

methods.name: toggle_stdout_metrics_app_command
methods.description: Constructor initializing the toggle command with available subcommands and auto-start option.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the command with provided arguments, selecting and running the appropriate subcommand.

methods.name: execute_subcommand
methods.description: Activates or deactivates a specific subcommand based on index.

methods.name: stop_current_active_subcommand
methods.description: Stops the currently active subcommand if any, ensuring only one is active at a time.

methods.name: get_subcommand_index
methods.description: Finds the index of a subcommand given its name.
